description:
Connect your Semagora account to find and follow public procurement opportunities. Search tenders, filter results, review company-specific recommendations, and track deadlines, lots, favorites and alerts. Update favorites and alert preferences only when you explicitly request the change.

Read available tender documents, extracted passages and existing analyses. Access to tender details and documents depends on your Semagora subscription and remaining quotas; some consultations can use an available access allowance.

For accounts enrolled in Semagora’s response-assistance pilot, consult company evidence and prepare response projects, requirements, solution proposals, drafts and DOCX working documents. Pilot features require the appropriate company role, enrollment and consent. Some stages need validation in Semagora, and generation jobs can run asynchronously under the account’s available budget.

A verified Semagora account and permission to access the selected company are required. Semagora does not submit bids or send responses to buyers. Your company must check the source information and review prepared documents before use.

defaultPrompt: Which public tenders match my company?
Show my favorites and alerts without changing anything.
Help me prepare a response using tender documents and my company knowledge.
